Our Blue Ribbon Survey 2027 announcement

The restaurant has announced its selection for Blue Ribbon Survey 2027 on Naver Place. Read the restaurant’s current announcement there.

The food behind the announcement

We have served oven-baked pizza and pasta between Hongdae, Hapjeong and Sangsu since opening in 2012. On your first visit, try the rim of our 72-hour-fermented dough, then take a bite of the center with cheese and toppings. The oven story shows how the pizza looks as it bakes.
